gloss: communication power; ability to spread a message

definitions.gloss: communication power; ability to influence through messaging
definitions.explanation: The ability to effectively communicate and spread one's message or ideas, especially through media or social platforms.

examples.japanese: {発信力|はっしんりょく}を{高|たか}める。
SNSの{発信力|はっしんりょく}は{大|おお}きい。
examples.english: The communication power of social media is great.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}の{魅力|みりょく}を{発信力|はっしんりょく}のある{人|ひと}に{伝|つた}えてもらいたい。
examples.english: I want someone with strong communication skills to convey the appeal of this area.

notes: A modern compound: {発信|はっしん} (transmission, broadcasting) + {力|りょく} (power, ability). Became widely used with the rise of social media and personal branding. Part of a series of 〜{力|りょく} compounds: {影響力|えいきょうりょく} (influence), {表現力|ひょうげんりょく} (expressive power), {訴求力|そきゅうりょく} (appeal). Collocations: {発信力|はっしんりょく}を{高|たか}める (strengthen communication power), {発信力|はっしんりょく}がある (to have strong outreach ability).
